arxiv-2206-04102.title: The missing radial velocities of Gaia : blind predictions for DR3 2022 The missing radial velocities of Gaia : blind predictions for DR3 – References
arxiv-2206-04102.creator: Aneesh P. Naik, Axel Widmark
arxiv-2206-04102.description: Abstract While Gaia has observed the phase space coordinates of over a billion stars in the Galaxy, in the overwhelming majority of cases it has only obtained five of the six coordinates, the missing dimension being the radial (line-of-sight) velocity.

arxiv-2306-15233.title: On the proportions of soluble forms in some families of locally soluble binary quartic forms
arxiv-2306-15233.creator: Yasuhiro Ishitsuka, Yoshinori Kanamura
arxiv-2306-15233.description: Abstract . An integral binary quartic form is said to be locally soluble (resp. soluble) if the corresponding genus one curve has a rational point over ℚ v \mathbb{Q}_{v} for every place v v of ℚ \mathbb{Q} (resp. over ℚ \mathbb{Q} ). We consider the proportion of soluble integral binary quartic forms in locally soluble forms.

arxiv-2308-09216.title: Dispersive effects in ultrafast non-linear phenomena
arxiv-2308-09216.creator: Dusan Lorenc, Zhanybek Alpichshev
arxiv-2308-09216.description: Abstract It is a basic principle that an effect cannot come before the cause. Dispersive relations that follow from this fundamental fact have proven to be an indispensable tool in physics and engineering. They are most powerful in the domain of linear response where they are known as Kramers-Kronig relations.

arxiv-2309-08874.title: Generalised Whittaker models as instances of relative Langlands duality
arxiv-2309-08874.creator: Wee Teck Gan, Bryan Wang Peng Jun
arxiv-2309-08874.description: Abstract . The recent proposal by Ben-Zvi, Sakellaridis and Venkatesh of a duality in the relative Langlands program, leads, via the process of quantization of Hamiltonian varieties, to a duality theory of branching problems. This often unexpectedly relates two a priori unrelated branching problems.

arxiv-2311-08464.title: Could very low-metallicity stars with rotation-dominated orbits have been shepherded by the bar?
arxiv-2311-08464.creator: Zhen Yuan ( 袁珍 ) ,, Chengdong Li ( 李承东 ) ,, Nicolas F. Martin, Giacomo Monari, Benoit Famaey, Arnaud Siebert, Anke Ardern-Arentsen, Federico Sestito, Guillaume F. Thomas, Vanessa Hill, Rodrigo A. Ibata, Georges Kordopatis, Else Starkenburg, Akshara Viswanathan
arxiv-2311-08464.description: Abstract The most metal-poor stars ( e.g., [Fe/H] ≤ − 2.5 \leq-2.5 ) are the ancient fossils from the early assembly epoch of our Galaxy, very likely before the formation of the thick disc. Recent studies have shown that a non-negligible fraction of them have prograde planar orbits, which makes their origin a puzzle.

arxiv-2405-05438.title: Information Extraction from Historical Well Records Using A Large Language Model
arxiv-2405-05438.creator: Zhiwei Ma, Javier E. Santos, Greg Lackey, Hari Viswanathan, Daniel O’Malley
arxiv-2405-05438.description: Abstract To reduce environmental risks and impacts from orphaned wells (abandoned oil and gas wells), it is essential to first locate and then plug these wells. Although some historical documents are available, they are often unstructured, not cleaned, and outdated. Additionally, they vary widely by state and type.

arxiv-2406-11418.title: BAMBINO-LM: (Bilingual-)Human-Inspired Continual Pre-training of BabyLM
arxiv-2406-11418.creator: Zhewen Shen Aditya Joshi Ruey-Cheng Chen
arxiv-2406-11418.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhewen Shen Aditya Joshi Ruey-Cheng Chen. Children from bilingual backgrounds benefit from interactions with parents and teachers to re-acquire their heritage language. In this paper, we investigate how this insight from behavioral study can be incorporated into the learning of small-scale language models. We introduce BAMBINO-LM, a continual pre-training strategy for BabyLM that uses a novel combination of alternation and PPO-based perplexity reward induced from a parent Italian model.

arxiv-2411-09547.title: Piecing It All Together: Verifying Multi-Hop Multimodal Claims
arxiv-2411-09547.creator: Haoran Wang ♡ Aman Rangapur ♡ Xiongxiao Xu ♡ Yueqing Liang ♡ Haroon Gharwi ♡ Carl Yang ♣ Kai Shu ♣ ♡ \heartsuit Illinois Institute of Technology ♣ \clubsuit Emory University {hwang219, arangapur, xxu85, yliang40, hgharwi}@hawk.iit.edu {j.carlyang, kai.shu}@emory.edu
arxiv-2411-09547.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Haoran Wang ♡ Aman Rangapur ♡ Xiongxiao Xu ♡ Yueqing Liang ♡ Haroon Gharwi ♡ Carl Yang ♣ Kai Shu ♣ ♡ \heartsuit Illinois Institute of Technology ♣ \clubsuit Emory University {hwang219, arangapur, xxu85, yliang40, hgharwi}@hawk.iit.edu {j.carlyang, kai.shu}@emory.edu. Existing claim verification datasets often do not require systems to perform complex reasoning or effectively interpret multimodal evidence. To address this, we introduce a new task: multi-hop multimodal claim verification.

arxiv-2504-14498.title: Assessing the Performance of Mixed-Precision ILU(0)-Preconditioned Multiple-Precision Real and Complex Krylov Subspace Methods
arxiv-2504-14498.creator: Tomonori Kouya
arxiv-2504-14498.description: Abstract Krylov subspace methods are linear solvers based on matrix-vector multiplications and vector operations. While easily parallelizable, they are sensitive to rounding errors and may experience convergence issues. ILU(0), an incomplete LU factorization with zero fill-in, is a well-known preconditioning technique that enhances convergence for sparse matrices.

arxiv-2506-13040.title: MAMMA: Markerless & Automatic Multi-Person Motion Action Capture XXXX CCS: Computing methodologies Motion capture CCS: Computing methodologies Computer vision
arxiv-2506-13040.creator: Hanz Cuevas-Velasquez 1, Anastasios Yiannakidis 1, Soyong Shin 2, Giorgio Becherini 1, Markus Höschle 1, Joachim Tesch 1, Taylor Obersat 1, Tsvetelina Alexiadis 1, Michael J. Black 1
arxiv-2506-13040.description: Abstract . We present MAMMA , a markerless motion-capture pipeline that accurately recovers SMPL-X parameters from multi-view video of two-person interaction sequences. Traditional motion-capture systems rely on physical markers. Although they offer high accuracy, their requirements of specialized hardware, manual marker placement, and extensive post-processing make them costly and time-consuming.

arxiv-2507-02810.title: Advancements in Computing and Simulation Techniques for the HIBEAM-NNBAR Experiment
arxiv-2507-02810.creator: \firstname First author \lastname First author \fnsep, \firstname Second author \lastname Second author \fnsep, \firstname Third author \lastname Third author \fnsep, \firstname Bernhard \lastname Meirose \fnsep, \firstname Jorge \lastname Amaral, \firstname Alexander \lastname Burgman, \firstname M
arxiv-2507-02810.description: Abstract The HIBEAM-NNBAR program is a proposed two-stage experiment at the European Spallation Source focusing on searches for baryon number violation processes as well as ultralight dark matter. This paper presents recent advancements in computing and simulation, including machine learning for event selection, fast parametric simulations for detector studies, and detailed modeling of the time projection chamber and readout electronics.

arxiv-2510-24393.title: Your Microphone Array Retains Your Identity: A Robust Voice Liveness Detection System for Smart Speakers
arxiv-2510-24393.creator: Yan Meng, Jiachun Li, Matthew Pillari, Arjun Deopujari, Liam Brennan, Hafsah Shamsie, Haojin Zhu, and Yuan Tian
arxiv-2510-24393.description: Abstract Though playing an essential role in smart home systems, smart speakers are vulnerable to voice spoofing attacks. Passive liveness detection, which utilizes only the collected audio rather than the deployed sensors to distinguish between live-human and replayed voices, has drawn increasing attention.

pmc-10553435.title: THU281 Real-World Survey Of Adherence To Guidelines Regarding Type 1 Diabetes And Aerobic Exercise
pmc-10553435.creator: Joseph Anthony Henske, Gavin Beach, Arwa Albashaireh
pmc-10553435.description: Disclosure: J.A. Henske: None. G. Beach: None. A. Albashaireh: None. Background: Managing hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia before, during, and after aerobic exercise remains one of the greatest challenges for those living with type 1 diabetes. Several publications offer guidelines and recommendations but it is not well established to what extent these are followed by those living with diabetes.

pmc-10572643.title: Nitric Oxide as a Determinant of Human Longevity and Health Span
pmc-10572643.creator: Burkhard Poeggeler, Sandeep Kumar Singh, Kumar Sambamurti, Miguel A Pappolla, Michele Samaja, Daniele Mancardi
pmc-10572643.description: The master molecular regulators and mechanisms determining longevity and health span include nitric oxide (NO) and superoxide anion radicals (SOR). L-arginine, the NO synthase (NOS) substrate, can restore a healthy ratio between the dangerous SOR and the protective NO radical to promote healthy aging.

pmc-12514476.title: Cryptococcoid Sweet syndrome or halogenoderma? Highlighting the crucial need for serum iodine testing
pmc-12514476.creator: Jacob R. Kilgore, Jonathan M. Joseph, Addie Walker, William Snider, Nicholas Culotta, Carson Bogatto, Aaron Coulon
pmc-12514476.description: ng all halogen exposure-related dermatoses, including iododerma, bromoderma (bromine exposure), and fluoroderma (fluorine exposure). The clinical manifestations of iododerma vary widely, ranging from acute, diffuse cutaneous eruptions within hours of exposure to a more chronic onset characterized by solitary lesions.2 The severity varies equally, ranging from self-limited to diffuse and fatal.

pmc-12695027.title: Evidence of centromeric histone 3 chaperone involved in DNA damage repair pathway in budding yeast
pmc-12695027.creator: Prakhar Agarwal, Anushka Alekar, Shubhomita Mallick, Kannan Harini, Santanu K Ghosh, Yamini Dalal
pmc-12695027.description: The centromeric protein-A (CENP-A) is an evolutionarily conserved histone H3 variant that marks the identity of the centromeres. Several mechanisms regulate the centromeric deposition of CENP-A as its mislocalization causes erroneous chromosome segregation, leading to aneuploidy-based diseases, including cancers. The most crucial deposition factor is a CENP-A specific chaperone, HJURP (Scm3 in budding yeast), which specifically binds to CENP-A.

pmc-13091172.title: Perioperative use of eculizumab in patients with thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis: A preliminary case series of five patients
pmc-13091172.creator: Yaotong Ou, Yi Wen, Yiyi Liu, Mingjun Lai, Honghao Wang, Xi Chen, Huili Zhang, Yu Peng
pmc-13091172.description: Patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) are at risk of myasthenic crisis (MC) or clinical deterioration following thymectomy. Although eculizumab has demonstrated efficacy in the management of MC, its role in perioperative optimization for thymectomy in MG patients has not been systematically evaluated.
